title: Smart Surveillance: Deep Learning and Hybrid Approaches for Dynamic Scene Analysis, Object Detection and Motion Tracking
abstract: arXiv:2412.05331v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Event-triggered recording reduces the footage a surveillance camera must store, but the trigger decides how much idle video is kept, how many events are missed, and how much computation is spent. We compare six motion triggers (frame differencing, dense optical flow, MOG2, KNN, CNT, GSOC), a CNN detector, strided detection, and three motion-gated hybrids under one recording policy, on a benchmark of seven static-camera scenes (5,800 frames, 27 annotated events) with thresholds transferred to unseen scenes by leave-one-video-out. Detector-based triggers stored 19-28% of idle frames, against 36-89% for motion triggers. Under simulated camera jitter, frame differencing, optical flow, MOG2 and KNN stored 97-100% of idle frames, while detector triggers stayed below 29%. Running the detector on every 8th frame kept 99.7% of event frames at 9.8 ms of CPU per frame, cheaper and more robust than gating it with background subtraction. On

translated_title: 智能监控：用于动态场景分析、目标检测与运动跟踪的深度学习与混合方法
translated_abstract: 事件触发的录像可以减少监控摄像头需要存储的视频量，但触发器的选择决定了保留多少空闲视频、遗漏多少事件以及消耗多少计算资源。我们在统一的录像策略下，比较了六种运动触发器（帧差法、稠密光流、MOG2、KNN、CNT、GSOC）、一个CNN检测器、隔帧检测以及三种运动门控混合方法，测试基准包含七个固定摄像头场景（5,800帧，27个标注事件），并通过留一视频法将阈值迁移到未见过的场景。结果表明，基于检测器的触发器仅存储19-28%的空闲帧，而运动触发器存储36-89%。在模拟摄像头抖动的条件下，帧差法、光流法、MOG2和KNN存储了97-100%的空闲帧，而检测器触发器仍保持在29%以下。每8帧运行一次检测器可保留99.7%的事件帧，每帧CPU耗时仅9.8毫秒，比使用背景减除进行门控更省算力且更稳健。
tldr: 该研究统一比较了多种运动触发器与深度学习检测器作为监控事件触发录像方案的性能，发现每8帧运行一次CNN检测器能以仅9.8毫秒/帧的开销保留99.7%的事件帧，比基于背景减除的门控方法更省算力且更能抵抗摄像头抖动。
en_tdlr: This study systematically compares motion triggers and deep learning detectors for event-triggered surveillance recording, showing that running a CNN detector every 8th frame retains 99.7% of event frames at only 9.8 ms of CPU per frame, making it cheaper and more robust to camera jitter than background-subtraction-based gating.
